repository_profile.runtime: C++20/Qt desktop application, offline audio rendering, WAV import/export and built-in plugin host
surfaces: audio buffers and DSP worker tasks
guardrails: Imported audio, manifests and external assets are untrusted inputs
Audio and plugin processing must retain declared size, frame, time and memory limits
An in-process plugin host is not a security sandbox; isolate third-party binaries at the OS boundary before claiming isolation

echelons.name: Hardware, kernel and runtime foundation
echelons.purpose: Protect process execution, memory, threads, descriptors, instruction and ABI boundaries.

echelons.name: Input streams, parsing and deserialization
echelons.purpose: Validate untrusted data at every boundary before parsing, conversion, storage or dispatch.

echelons.name: Identity, access, sessions and cryptography
echelons.purpose: Bind every protected operation to verified identity, authority, session and key lifecycle.

echelons.name: Data, state, transactions, caches and queues
echelons.purpose: Preserve state invariants across writes, transactions, concurrency, caches, queues and recovery.

echelons.name: Network boundaries, integrations, plugins and dependencies
echelons.purpose: Constrain network access, external peers, callbacks, dependencies, plugins and executable extensions.

echelons.name: Telemetry, abuse resistance, degradation and correlation
echelons.purpose: Detect abuse and failures, preserve audit evidence, degrade safely and correlate repository/runtime risk.
